details.description:
Mentos is well known and well-loved. For generations, Mentos chewy has been known as a fresh candy/toffee. This round shaped candy perfectly combines taste and freshness in a single dragee, with the goodness of real fruit. These orange flavoured dragees are crunchy outside, and soft inside. 
Coming from the credible brand of Perfetti, this cool and fresh confectionary is very popular among consumers for its fresh look and feel. So, if you have a roll of Mentos in your hand, it’s the best ice-breaker and conversation starter. Go ahead and enjoy the fresh start! Refreshing orange flavoured chewy dragees are now bigger and softer.
